Senses.PreferredTarget: could not lift it at Dayu Ridge
SearchAliases: could not lift the robe at Dayu Ridge
Senses.Explanation: A fixed allusion to the robe in the Huineng–Ming encounter that could not be lifted at Dayu Ridge. Poshan Haiming and Tian'an Sheng deploy the allusion directly; unnamed monks invoke it in questions to Feiyin Tongrong and Wanru Tongwei.
Senses.Note: Later applications to presented or transmitted robes remain deployments of the same allusion rather than separate senses.
